ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given that $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, and the chord $CD$ intersects $AB$ at point $E$. A tangent to $\odot O$ at point $C$ intersects the extension of $BA$ at point $P$, with $\angle BPC=38^\circ$. Connect $OD$. If $D$ is the midpoint of $\overset{\frown}{AB}$, what is the measure of $\angle ODC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in Figure 1, connect $OC$, \\
since $D$ is the midpoint of $\overset{\frown}{AB}$,\\
it follows that $\overset{\frown}{AD}=\overset{\frown}{BD}$,\\
thus $\angle AOD=\angle BOD=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB=90^\circ$,\\
since $PC$ is the tangent to the circle $\odot O$ at point $C$,\\
it follows that $\angle PCO=90^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle POC=90^\circ-\angle BPC=90^\circ-38^\circ=52^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle COD=\angle POC+\angle AOD=52^\circ+90^\circ=142^\circ$,\\
since $OC=OD$,\\
it follows that $\angle OCD=\angle ODC$,\\
thus $\angle OCD=\angle ODC=\frac{180^\circ-\angle COD}{2}=\frac{180^\circ-142^\circ}{2}=19^\circ$\\
hence, $\angle ODC=\boxed{19^\circ}$;

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the attached figure there are two schematic diagrams. According to the problem statement “D is the midpoint of arc AB” and combining the specified method, use the configuration of Figure ①: AB is a horizontal diameter, and O is on AB; P is on the left-side extension of BA; PC is tangent to the circle at the upper-left point C of the circle; D is the midpoint of the lower semicircular arc, so OD is perpendicular to AB; chord CD intersects AB at E. Then reason: Since P, A, O, B are collinear, ∠BPC is ∠OPC, which is known to be 38°. Connect OC. By the tangent-radius theorem, OC⊥PC, so in right triangle OPC, ∠POC=90°−38°=52°. Also because D is the midpoint of the lower semicircular arc AB, ∠AOD=90°; and viewed from O, OA and OP are the same leftward ray, so ∠COA=∠POC=52°. Therefore ∠COD=∠COA+∠AOD=52°+90°=142°. In triangle OCD, OC=OD are both radii of the circle, so triangle OCD is an isosceles triangle, and ∠ODC=∠OCD=(180°−142°)/2=19°.
